Question: Is it possible to install Linux in an USB device and boot any system from that USB?
Answer: You can either copy a iso image of a live CD/DVD, and run it as a live system, or even full install Linux to a usb pen. That will not make it as portable, though, although it will probably run on most computers. I did pick a harddisk from a computer, connect it to another computer, and it will boot and run. Most of the times. Something you will never be able to do with windows. I also have a bootable external hard disk with Linux installed i can connect to any computer, and it will run. Running as a live system will be read-only, though, unless you set another partition in the pen to store your data. However, apps you install will be lost after you shut the system down. Or plugins on Firefox. Stuff like that. For me, i use the external harddisk as my “portable Linux”, when i need. Great to recover data from infected computers, since Linux is immune to windows viruses.

Question: Do you actually need to have flavors for your e-cigarette?
Answer: If you are smoking and want to change to vaping, flavors are instrumental in the process. Smokers miss the tobacco flavor in their mouth, so they will want it. E-cigarettes with an e-liquid tobacco flavored will fill one more of his needs, so that he doesn’t miss the cigarettes. Then, he will find additional flavors he can use and appreciate, and the scope of the sensations that e-cigs will give him will broaden. That in itself will keep him experimenting and not want to go back to cigarettes. So, i think flavors are important for someone that wants to stop smoking. If you are a seasoned vaper and like the flavor of pure glycerin, sure! Why not? However, flavors tend to saturate. In the same way that when you enter a house and you notice a weird smell, but a few minutes later you don’t notice it anymore. Flavors and smells saturate. As a vaper, i like to vary flavors. I usually have several atomizers loaded with different flavors, so that i can change the flavor easily, thus avoiding the saturation of any of the flavors, keeping vaping enjoyable.

Question: Do games/applications that say Ubuntu also work on Linux Mint? I’m a noob at Linux.
Answer: Yes, it will work. Ubuntu is the main component of Mint, so it will run the apps. Also, the package manager is the same, so programs packaged for Ubuntu will also install and run on Mint.

Question: If a person smokes 65 times a day, how often is that per hour?
Answer: Typically, a person is awake 16 hours per day. So, 65 cigarettes/16h = 4.063 cigarettes per hour, or one cigarette every roughly 15 minutes.
